STEP 13. Check for harness damage between engine 
coolant temperature sensor connector B-11 terminal 1 and 
ECM connector C-58 terminal 44 <M/T> or PCM connector 
C-55 terminal 44 <A/T>.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES : Replace the ECM or PCM. Then go to Step 14.
NO : Repair it. Then go to Step 14.
STEP 14. Test the OBD-II drive cycle.
(1) Carry out a test drive with the drive cycle pattern. Refer to 
P.13B-4, Procedure 6 − Other Monitor.
(2) Check the diagnostic trouble code (DTC).
Q: Is the DTC P0115 is output?
YES : Retry the troubleshooting.
NO : The inspection is complete.
